description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the TenantClientFactoryImpl class, which is responsible for creating and managing TenantClient instances within the Hono client framework. It extends an abstract factory class and implements the TenantClientFactory interface, providing methods to create tenant clients, handle disconnections, and manage client caching.

classes.name: TenantClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of TenantClientFactory responsible for creating and managing tenant-specific client instances, with support for caching and connection lifecycle handling.

methods.name: TenantClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a connection and cache provider, and setting up a caching client factory.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup actions on disconnection, specifically clearing cached tenant clients.

methods.name: getOrCreateTenantClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing TenantClient asynchronously, based on the current connection state.

methods.name: removeTenantClient
methods.description: Removes tenant client from cache based on tenantId, although tenantId is ignored in this implementation.
